Algorithm (Mifflin-St Jeor): BMR = 10×weight (kg) + 6.25×height (cm) − 5×age + (male +5 / female −161), in kcal/day. All values must be >0.
map.BMR 和 TDEE 区别？: What is the difference between BMR and TDEE?
map.BMR 是躺着不动的最低消耗；TDEE = BMR × 活动系数（久坐约 1.2: BMR is the minimum burn while lying still; TDEE = BMR × activity factor (about 1.2 sedentary, 1.55 moderate, 1.9 high intensity) is the total daily expenditure. Fat-loss intake should be slightly below TDEE.
map.公式适合所有人吗？: Is the formula suitable for everyone?
map.Mifflin-St Jeor 对普通成人较准；运动员、孕妇、甲亢/减等特殊情况: Mifflin-St Jeor is fairly accurate for ordinary adults; athletes, pregnant women and special situations such as hyperthyroidism/hypothyroidism deviate a lot, so it is only an estimate.
